sect1.title: Introduction
sect1.para: This program demonstrates the use of the Dual-Clock Comparator (DCC) module to perform a single-shot measurement of the SYSOSCDIV4 clock frequency using the XTAL clock as a reference

sect3.title: Details
sect3.para: The DCC module is configured to measure the frequency of the SYSOSCDIV4 clock (Fclk1) using the XTAL clock (Fclk0) as a reference. The reference clock frequency is set to 20 MHz, and the measured clock frequency is expected to be approximately 8 Hz. The program sets an initial seed value for the DCC counters and verifies the measured frequency against an expected range.

entry.para: 0% (can be updated based on XTAL error)

sect3.para: The result of the measurement is stored in the result variable, which indicates whether the measurement was successful (PASS) or not (FAIL). The measured frequency is stored in the meas_freq1 variable.

entry.para: Status of the SYSOSCDIV4 clock measurement (PASS or FAIL).
